test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A motorist covers a distance of 30 km in 50 minutes by moving at a speed of x km/hr for the first 13 minutes, then moving at the speed of 2x km/hr for the next 25 minutes and then again moving at the speed of x km/hr for the rest of the journey. The value of x is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 50 minutes. Breakdown: 13 mins (x), 25 mins (2x), and remaining (50 − 13 − 25) = 12 mins (x).

Total **Equivalent Time** at speed x = 13 + (25 × 2) + 12 = 13 + 50 + 12 = 75 minutes.

Distance = Speed × Time ⇒ 30 km = x × (75/60) hours.

x = (30 × 60) ÷ 75 = 1800 ÷ 75 = 24 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39eab6c88357c4165bde0d3619593a7fd81ed9a3a2ae66657e3ffba47d147a91.png] 

**Given:** Total Distance = 30 km, Total Time = 50 min.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Third part time = 50 − (13 + 25) = 12 minutes.

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (13/60) km

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (25/60) km

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (12/60) km

⇒ Total Distance = (13x/60) + (50x/60) + (12x/60) = 30

⇒ 75x/60 = 30

⇒ 5x/4 = 30

⇒ 5x = 120

⇒ x = 24 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. In this case, 30 km ÷ (50/60) hours = 36 km/hr.

Unit Conversion

To convert **minutes to hours**, divide by 60. To convert **km/hr to m/s**, multiply by 5/18.

Distance with Variable Speeds

Total Distance = (S₁ × T₁) + (S₂ × T₂) + ... + (Sₙ × Tₙ), ensuring all units are consistent.</p
